result_summary.title: CRITICAL: Payment Gateway Capacity/Quota Exhaustion in EU-West
result_summary.description: We are experiencing a critical outage with Payment Gateway v2 in the EU-West production environment. Transactions are failing with messages indicating 'capacity limit reached' and 'quota exceeded'. This is affecting 8,701 users and is directly blocking revenue generation. We need immediate assistance to increase our limits or resolve the underlying capacity issue to restore service.
